CeruleanCity_House2_Text_MakeRoomForTM28.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la place\net reviens chercher la CT.
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_MakeRoomForTM28.en: Your bag is full. Make room\nand come back for the TM.

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMF.fr: J'ai trouvé cette CT sur un sentier\nde la forêt. Elle enseigne TUNNEL.\pMes POKéMON ne s'en servent pas.\nPrends-la, tu en auras besoin !
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMF.en: I found this TM on a forest trail.\nIt teaches DIG.\pMy POKéMON can't use it. Take it,\nyou look like you'll need it!

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDig.fr: Les ponts craquent un peu avec\nle vent. On s'y habitue.
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDig.en: The bridges creak a little in\nthe wind. You get used to it.

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryin.fr: J'adore vivre au bord de la\nrivière. L'eau chante la nuit.
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryin.en: I love living by the river.\nThe water sings at night.
